validations.pageName-invalid: Page name can contain alphanumeric, "_", "-" and "." characters only
validations.permalink-invalid: Other pages have the same permalink

hints.rename-in-git: This store publishes pages through Git, where the file name is the page's address in the repository. Rename it there, through a pull request.

duplicate.title: Duplicate page
duplicate.description: Copy the page into the content repository under a new name

create.title: Design page
create.description: Use designer to create a new page

git-promote-pending.title: Promotion in progress
git-promote-pending.message: Production is not updated yet: a pull request is open and will merge once its checks pass. {{url}}

delete-legacy-draft.title: Delete the old draft file?
delete-legacy-draft.message: "{{path}}" is left over from before this store moved to the content repository. The page itself is not touched.

delete-legacy-draft-unsaved.title: Delete the old draft file?
delete-legacy-draft-unsaved.message: "{{path}}" still holds changes that are not in the content repository. Deleting it loses them. The published page is not touched.

legacy-draft-kept.title: The draft file was kept
legacy-draft-kept.message: Nothing else holds this page: it is in neither the content repository nor a published file, so deleting the draft would delete the page. Save it from the designer once, then delete the draft.

git-publish-pending.title: Publishing in progress
git-publish-pending.message: The page is not live yet: a pull request is open and will merge once its checks pass. {{url}}

git-unpublish-pending.title: Unpublishing in progress
git-unpublish-pending.message: The page is still live: a pull request that removes it is open and will merge once its checks pass. {{url}}

StoreUrl.description: Store URL with Page Builder preview handler
StoreUrl.title: Store URL

OzAgentUrl.title: Virto OZ agent URL
OzAgentUrl.description: URL of the Virto OZ AI agent iframe embedded into Page Builder. Leave empty to disable the AI assistant.

PreviewUserIds.title: Preview user IDs
PreviewUserIds.description: List of user IDs for page preview impersonation (one per line)

GitContentEnabled.title: Publish pages through Git
GitContentEnabled.description: When enabled, saving a page commits it to a work branch in the configured content repository and publishing opens and merges a pull request, instead of writing to blob storage directly. Requires the Git content connection to be configured on the server (PageBuilder:GitContent).

MetadataFromContentMigrated.title: Metadata migration from content completed
MetadataFromContentMigrated.description: The metadata migration from content items to Page Builder pages has been completed successfully.

permissions.builder:templates: Allow to change template during editing
permissions.builder:promote: Allow to promote a page to production. Separate from publishing, which only reaches the environment editors work against.
